description: This file defines a custom Next.js Document component (_document.tsx) with server-side rendering logic, including methods for managing scripts, styles, and AMP mode handling. It exports classes and functions used for rendering the initial HTML document structure in a Next.js app.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Main React component class for server-side rendering of the HTML document structure in Next.js, including methods for initial props, rendering, and managing scripts and styles.

classes.name: Head
classes.description: React component for managing the <head> section of the document, including preload links, styles, AMP handling, and warnings.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Component that renders the main application HTML or AMP target.

classes.name: NextScript
classes.description: Component responsible for injecting Next.js runtime scripts, data, and handling AMP mode scripts.

methods.name: getInitialProps
methods.description: Static method to fetch initial props for the Document, including rendering the page and collecting styles.

methods.name: renderDocument
methods.description: Static method to render a custom Document component with provided props.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Instance method to render the full HTML document structure including <Html>, <Head>, <Main>, and <NextScript> components.

methods.name: getCssLinks
methods.description: Method to generate CSS link elements for stylesheets.

methods.name: getPreloadDynamicChunks
methods.description: Method to generate preload links for dynamic JavaScript chunks.

methods.name: getPreloadMainLinks
methods.description: Method to generate preload links for main JavaScript files.

methods.name: getDynamicChunks
methods.description: Method to generate script tags for dynamic chunks.

methods.name: getPreNextScripts
methods.description: Method to generate script tags for preloading scripts.

methods.name: getScripts
methods.description: Method to generate script tags for main scripts.

methods.name: getPolyfillScripts
methods.description: Method to generate polyfill script tags.

methods.name: getInlineScriptSource
methods.description: Static method to generate inline script content with serialized __NEXT_DATA__.
